items.title: Portugal updates cybercrime law to exempt security researchers
items.description: Portugal has modified its cybercrime law to establish a legal safe harbor for good-faith security research and to make hacking non-punishable under certain strict conditions. [...]

items.title: Cybersecurity News Weekly Newsletter – 29.7 Tbps DDoS Attack, Chrome 143, React2Shell Vulnerabilities, and Cloudflare Outage
items.description: This week’s cybersecurity landscape featured a record-breaking 29.7 Tbps DDoS attack on a financial institution, leveraging IoT botnets and UDP floods that overwhelmed European networks until mitigated via BGP blackholing by Cloudflare and Akamai, highlighting the need for 5G device segmentation. Google released Chrome 143, patching 12 high-severity flaws, including three actively exploited…
